copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: Claude 会把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进项目的 src/channels/、注册到 barrel 并安装 @chat-adapter/whatsapp，然后跑构建和注册测试；它还会依次提示你粘贴 Meta 凭据并写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目添加 WhatsApp 官方 Cloud API 渠道时触发；在 /setup 流程中接入该渠道时也会接管。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp Cloud API 渠道加到项目里
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并装依赖，再跑构建

say.text: 运行 whatsapp-cloud 的注册测试，看适配器是否注册成功
say.note: 测试变红说明导入或依赖出了问题

say.text: 帮我把 Meta 的四个凭据写进 .env
say.note: 会依次提示你粘贴 token、ID 等

howto.what_en: Claude copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the barrel, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, then runs the build and the registration test. It also prompts for your Meta credentials and writes them to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the official WhatsApp Cloud API channel to the project, or when you wire this channel during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs deps, builds

say_en.text: Run the whatsapp-cloud registration test to check the adapter
say_en.note: Red means the import or the dependency drifted

say_en.text: Write my four Meta credentials into .env
say_en.note: Prompts you to paste the token, IDs, and secret
